what: An 8×8 cell plate covering the screen fills up tied to scroll. Each cell’s border (square, quarter circle, semicircle) is drawn from the center to both ends (at frames 0, 5, 10 and 15, 26 frames long), 10 frames later the background-color shape fills in over 16 frames, and less-covered cells fill fully at frames 29 and 34 over 6 frames, linear. All 42 frames are spread over the section’s progress from~to. When full, only a faint border pattern remains over the background color and becomes the next section’s background

options.cols: Number of columns, default 8 — same number for rows (a square board is cropped from the top to cover)
options.from: Section progress at which filling begins, default .5
options.to: Progress at which the section is full, default 1
options.end: ScrollTrigger end where section progress finishes, default 「bottom bottom+=10%」
options.seed: Number of seeds that pick cell shapes, default 7 — same seed gives the same layout every time
options.[data-fx-part=canvas]: Where to draw the panel (if any) — a panel pinned to the screen. If absent, it is drawn on the section itself

note: The original steps a Lottie (131 shape layers) by scroll frames. The parts are drawn directly in SVG with the same cells and the same frame count, so they attach without lottie — the site copy (index.js) loads the animation data we built into lottie-web 5.13, like the original

from.where: index.html .ar-fv · .ar-shapes (from 50–100% of the 300lvh hero, a brown cell covers the video) — original firstView component + shapes.json
